_doc: Revert-verify mutants for req fe50da38-4798-46e6-bb0a-b4b88596c340 (issue #4440), NoteToRDFConverter half — the WIRING and the cost guarantee. Same harness and axis names as the adapter spec; separate file because mutant-driver takes ONE subject. Expectations written BEFORE the run.

C1_probe_result_not_awaited._note: Drops the `await` while keeping the declared type, so the defect is behavioural, not a compile error: a PROMISE is truthy, so every frontmatter-less plain note is reported as skipped with `reason: undefined`. B2 reddens on the false positive, B1 on the lost diagnosis. This is why the port was WIDENED rather than kept sync-only — the await is load-bearing, and now something proves it.

C2_loop_back_to_the_cache_only_reader._note: The pre-#4440 resolution tier. On a cold metadataCache EVERY file then looks frontmatter-less, so (B4) the diagnostic probe is asked about well-formed assets too — one extra full disk read per file on the plugin's cold eager walk — and (B5) the valid asset reaches convertNoteFromFrontmatter with null and contributes ZERO triples. ⛤ The first expectation named B3 instead of B5 and was WRONG about its own premise, not about the mutant: B3 runs on a WARM cache, where the cache-only reader returns the same frontmatter, so B3 is insensitive to the resolution tier BY CONSTRUCTION (integration-test-revert-verify §A44 — the prediction was derived from the mutant's THEME rather than from which axes actually execute after it lands). The fix was to add the missing COLD-cache axis (B5), not to relax the expectation: without it a revert of this one line would silently produce an empty store during every cold start, which is worse than the defect #4440 closes. B1/B2 stay green — the malformed file is still probed and still reported, the plain note still is not. ⛤ SECOND correction, same class: B6 also reddens, and the reason is read rather than smoothed over — this mutant REPLACES the `getFrontmatterWithFallback` call, so the resolution B6 counts never happens at all (observed list empty). That makes C2 a superset of C4 on B6, which is why C4 exists separately: it is the ONLY mutant that isolates the reuse from the resolution tier.

C3_probe_never_wired_into_the_walk.to: const parseFailure = null as { reason: string } | null;
C3_probe_never_wired_into_the_walk._note: The WIRING axis (feature-sdd Step 4 §the added CALL SITE): the adapter capability is fully implemented and simply never asked. Without this mutant an adapter-only axis set would have shipped a capability that nothing calls — 100% green, zero effect. B4 reddens because the probe is never called at all; B1 because nothing is reported.

C4_resolve_again_instead_of_reusing._note: The cost half on its own: `convertNote` re-resolves the frontmatter the loop has already resolved, so a cold walk pays two resolutions (and two disk reads) per file. BEHAVIOURALLY equivalent — which is exactly why it needs its own axis: no correctness axis can see it, and without B6 this line could be reverted under a fully green suite. Narrow by construction: B6 is the only axis that counts resolutions.
